context_requirements: Expression of DDC and a monoamine/aromatic amino acid substrate pool; none of the nine lines are known to depend on DDC for survival or transcriptional state.
Catecholamine/indoleamine synthesis capacity, which is absent or negligible in most of these lines.
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines.
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines at 10 micromolar that is absent in vehicle controls.
Evidence of DDC pathway dependence or monoamine synthesis in these lines that would make DDC inhibition transcriptionally consequential.
